name: Al-Simma al-Qushayri
bio: Al-Simma was an Umayyad poet of Banu Qushayr, a branch of Amir ibn Sa'sa'a. In his love poetry the summer camps and spring pastures of Najd come back into view even as the road takes him farther away. Al-Zirikli says he moved from the Iraqi desert to Syria and died in Tabaristan on his way to Daylam, around 95 AH (714 CE).
